answer.explanation: InvoiceReportController, in the presentation layer, imports and is constructor-injected with InvoiceRepository from the persistence layer. It calls totalFor directly, so it skips the business layer. FF-S03 flags this because the layering requires presentation to go through business. The README states this rule. It grants its one exception to admin-report.controller.ts and says invoice-report.controller.ts must go through a service. The code does the opposite of what the README declares, and the exception does not cover this file.
